verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a search that tolerates inexact wording, returns quick results and works offline on all devices (capacities-docs-10, capacities-docs-22, capacities-docs-50), and block search can find text inside content (capacities-docs-46). The evidence only glancingly mentions an "extended search" and smart queries, which can be opened as a graph on tags or queries (capacities-docs-47, capacities-docs-27), with no documented search filters on tags, properties or paths. missing for 10: documented search filters on tags, properties and paths, explicit full-text indexing detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of search speed and offline search.
